words.example: Members of the jury listened carefully to both sides.

example_translations.uz: Hakamlar hay'ati a'zolari ikkala tomonni diqqat bilan tingladi.

words.example: Everyone stood up when the judge entered the courtroom.

example_translations.ru: Все встали, когда судья вошёл в зал суда.
example_translations.uz: Sudya sud zaliga kirganda hamma o'rnidan turdi.

words.example: Has the jury reached a verdict yet?
Her attorney advised her not to sign anything.

example_translations.ru: Её адвокат посоветовал ей ничего не подписывать.
example_translations.uz: Advokati unga hech narsaga imzo qo'ymaslikni maslahat berdi.

words.example: The defendant said he was not guilty.
Each witness takes an oath to tell the truth.

example_translations.ru: Каждый свидетель даёт клятву говорить правду.
example_translations.uz: Har bir guvoh haqiqatni aytishga qasam ichadi.

words.example: Her testimony helped the court understand the case.

example_translations.ru: Её показания помогли суду разобраться в деле.
example_translations.uz: Uning ko'rsatuvlari sudga ishni tushunishda yordam berdi.

words.example: The prosecutor asked the witness several questions.

example_translations.uz: Prokuror guvohga bir nechta savol berdi.

words.example: Two customers filed a lawsuit against the store.

example_translations.ru: Два покупателя подали иск против магазина.
example_translations.uz: Ikki xaridor do'konga qarshi sudga da'vo kiritdi.

words.example: The court will hear his appeal next month.

example_translations.ru: Суд рассмотрит его апелляцию в следующем месяце.
example_translations.uz: Sud uning apellyatsiyasini kelasi oy ko'rib chiqadi.
